title: Local vents and stacks for bedpan washers.
officialText:
Bedpan washers shall be vented to open air above the roof by means of one or
more local vents. The local vent for a bedpan washer shall not be less than a 2-inch-diameter (51 mm) pipe. A local vent serving a
single bedpan washer is permitted to drain to the fixture served.
